title: Reduce completion preflight to refusal-only replay
outcome: Keyless completion retries always recompute after a refusal, while committed success replay remains stable and the store schema is unchanged.
acceptance: A cancelled and waived required child lets the next parent completion succeed instead of replaying the prior refusal.
A newly sealed required child lets the next parent completion succeed.
Explicit completion targets are checked before replay.
Parent status shows the child's real lifecycle and a runnable remedy.
Sibling activity does not perturb successful replay identity.
The slice adds no tables, triggers, counters, or integrity-replay machinery.

completion.summary: Delivered by 1d04b09 (refusals recomputed, never replayed; committed success replays by target; disposed child named with a runnable --waive; no tables, triggers, counters, or integrity-replay machinery).
